acceptanceCriteria: Implement harness:orchestrate dry-run with a delegated read-only planner that classifies when needed and invokes exactly one allowlisted dry-run/status/check helper.
Return normalized dry-run JSON with selected path, delegated command, status, blockers, missing artifacts, HITL gates, next safe actions, writesFiles=false, and raw output excerpts on errors.
Ambiguous or low-confidence classification must request clarification and run no helper.
Reject unsafe delegated commands including apply, run, create, merge apply, raw git merge, and direct runtime JSON mutation.
Dry-run writes no files and includes unit/integration coverage plus operator wrapper delegation.
planning.tddSlice: given a Phase 1 product_pipeline classification, delegate exactly one harness:product-pipeline dry-run --json helper and normalize the result

acceptanceCriteria: Use a dedicated git worktree/branch and do not mutate tracked files on root main.
Validate targeted tests, static checks, foundation compile, core regression, and git diff --check before PR.
Create PR, verify checks, merge to origin/main when gates pass, and sync local root main to origin/main or record blocker.
